name: Should you build a prefab or custom backyard guest house?

mainEntity.name: Which is better in Los Angeles: a prefab guest house or a fully custom build?
mainEntity.text: Which is better in Los Angeles: a prefab guest house or a fully custom build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prefab is attractive when speed, predictability, and budget control matter most. It can reduce some design and construction time, especially on simple sites with easy access. Custom construction is the better fit when the goal is to match an existing home, solve complex lot conditions, or create a high-end guest house that feels fully integrated with the main property. In Los Angeles, many homeowners prefer custom work because lots are often irregular, sloped, or architecturally sensitive. The right choice depends on whether the project priority is fast occupancy or a tailored result. Before deciding, compare total installed cost, not just the base unit price, because delivery, crane access, foundation work, utility hookups, and finish upgrades can change the final number significantly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prefab can be faster and simpler, while custom builds offer better fit, finishes, and site-specific design. In Los Angeles, prefab often works best on straightforward lots with standard expectations, while custom construction is usually better for luxury homes, difficult sites, and exact architectural matching.
